title: Taunton Municipal Lighting Plant files for the Department review and approval, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 56D, of power purchase contract with MM Taunton Energy, LLC.
filings: Memorandum from William H. Stevens, Jr., Re: Close of Docket - On November 25, 1997, the Governor signed into law Chapter 164 of the Acts of 1997. Section 198 of the Act amended G.L. c. 164, § 56D and resinds Department authority to review and approve municipal light plant supply contracts. Accordingly, this docket is hereby closed.
